notes: The behaviour is unchanged; now the model uses SynQ interfaces. Variables describe the connections in this abstract synchronous structural model.

Briefly name state, input and output types. UInt8 is an unsigned eight-bit input, and BitVec 1 is a one-bit result. !* marks the state representation; avoid a detour into the full modality calculus. The full source signature and definition are visible, with the result-type row emphasised.
The context supplies the available component interfaces, Seq comb seq and Primitive comb. Connect to P21: the supplied operations determine the available component construction vocabulary.

The context also supplies exactly one register resource. Multiplicity 1 accounts for its use when constructing this model, not a single operation over the system lifetime. Connect to P10 and P21. The type assumptions constrain construction; the signature alone does not prove rising detection.
Unpack the register as MkReg get set. These interfaces refer to the same register resource, rather than two independent registers. Follow the first construction view.
Name the input xin using abst. The variable describes a connection. The previous register interfaces remain available in the construction.
Read the previously stored value pre from get. This names the old value so that the comparison can use it later in the construction.

Connect the current input xin to set as the next stored value. pre still refers to the value read earlier, even though set occurs before the comparison in the do notation. Do not infer arbitrary physical scheduling from host-language statement order.
Compare the previous value pre with the current input xin using ltu. Do not rename or reorder get, set, pre, xin or ltu. The diagram now shows the comparison component and its connections.

Return the one-bit comparison result and connect it to the system output. This variable-based construction supports the accessibility objective O3. Transition: The type controls which components and resources construct the model. We can also express a behavioural property in a dependent type. Do not say that this structural signature already proves rising detection.
